notes.title: July Update: Introducing Surf Mode, Stats, New Achievements & Sale!

Now you can check your all-time surf stats and track your progress.[/p][h3][b]4 New Steam Achievements[/b][/h3][p]Challenge yourself and unlock 4 new achievements designed for Surf Mode.[/p][h3][b]Summer Sale[/b][/h3][p]Don’t miss out! The game goes on sale starting July 10th.[/p][p][/p][p]More updates are coming soon—stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634211/c2bb97db2ea00686b89ab809843063d9d1cd26ee.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634211/1e82c5b732270aa15cc283f5301656f0ada09196.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634211/22ca3b1d217fb529b1e0eedfd12f7cfab1df8e5c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Preview on Juli updates!
notes.content:
[h1]
Welcome![/h1][p]We hope gravity has been kind to you![/p][p]We at [i]computerfamilie[/i] are working on several rather impactful content updates and would like to let you all know what's coming over the next few weeks. Here’s what’s dropping this July:[/p][hr][/hr][h3]The Adventures of Little Surfel[/h3][p]Is that a typo? It isn’t! Get ready to wipe out as you surf across in-game elements for maximum fun and cool new achievements. And no, we’re not jumping the shark — but there will be a bit of extra focus on riding your friendly finned companion from Swords & Sharks.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Moof! It’s Raining Cows and Dogs[/h3][p]Our legendary chum “Sharky McSharkson” won’t be alone for long now. He’s getting company: Cows and Dogs are coming as brand-new palette elements. Naturally, they’re bringing a fresh batch of quirky achievements for you to chase![/p][hr][/hr][h3]Little Wurfel The Musical (Update)[/h3][p]Over the next few weeks, we’re tuning things up! The Palette Feature will get a new musical option, letting you choose your favorite background tracks. And yes, a selection of all-new musical compositions will be added to the game to keep your ears entertained while you play.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Mark Your Calendars![/h3][p]All these updates are part of our July update cycle, starting Thursday, July 3rd. So stay tuned and thanks for sticking with us![/p][hr][/hr][h3]Bonus: Special Release Sale Incoming![/h3][p]From July 10th to July 17th, we’re celebrating our big July update with a Special Release Sale! [i]The Adventures of Little Wurfel[/i] will be available at 50% off, so grab the game at a sweet discount while the wave lasts![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45634211/fc72d210d2d18f31298b129bcfba71f1c3997dc9.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45634211/6311ba98508c68b0409626cdbf750735811452ed.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45634211/8696d63c82abf7ada54242524a5defc6b5652a4b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45634211/c1097a14f3a4737bc156223c833ad3f31485e84c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Major Update - All New Palette Feature!
notes.content: [p]🎨 [b]New Palette Feature Just Dropped![/b] 🎮[/p][p]We’ve just rolled out the [i]All-New Palette Feature[/i], giving you the power to pick your favorite background colors and create amazing combos with your top elements — including some fan favorites from [b]Swords & Sharks[/b]! 🦈⚔️[/p][p]This is just the beginning. The Palette will be the foundation for [b]future updates[/b], with new elements, expanded game modes, and fresh achievements coming your way. Stay tuned and start crafting your ultimate style now! 💥✨[/p]
